integrity_notes: The theorem is established by an explicit cellular Lefschetz calculation and uniform top-cycle vanishing proof, with reproducible exact finite verification. Novelty is assessed relative to inspected sources, not definitive global publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Rational first-homology character for two unordered particles only; complex irreducible summands do not specify an integral lattice. Ordinary quotient rational homology does not imply contractibility or vanishing fundamental group.
title: Complete dihedral first-homology characters for two particles on wheel graphs
